subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Timeshare Fraud
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Timeshare Fraud.

hook.text: A free resort weekend leads to a four-hour sales pitch. You sign a contract you can't escape.

buildup.text: Timeshare presentations use high-pressure tactics and artificial scarcity to force quick decisions.

discovery.text: Most timeshares lose value immediately. Resale markets are flooded with owners desperate to exit.

twist.text: Timeshare exit companies charge thousands to help you leave — and many of those are scams too.

climax.text: The FTC warns that timeshare resale scams are now as common as the original timeshare fraud.

punchline.text: Getting in is easy. Getting out costs more than staying.

quiz.question: What happens to most timeshares after purchase?
